title: NASA's Mars Helicopter Was Built for 5 Flights. It Flew 72

scenes.text: NASA built a helicopter for five flights on Mars. It flew seventy-two.
Ingenuity landed in 2021 with a one month mission.
Its first flight in April 2021 was the first powered flight on another planet.
It kept flying for almost three years, going over two hours in the air.
Its final flight was in January 2024, when a rotor blade broke on landing.
The little helicopter that flew fourteen times its warranty.

description:
Ingenuity was planned for up to five flights over 30 days on Mars. It completed 72 flights over almost three years.
Its total time in the air was more than two hours, and its last flight ended in January 2024 with a damaged rotor blade.
What should NASA send next? Comment below.
first_comment: Ingenuity was meant to prove flight on another world was possible. What other planet would you want a drone to explore?
